maddeler.e:
نتقارص (form VI)
# نَتَقَارَصُ (nataqāraṣu) /na.ta.qaː.ra.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
# نَتَقَارَصَ (nataqāraṣa) /na.ta.qaː.ra.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
# نَتَقَارَصْ (nataqāraṣ) /na.ta.qaː.rasˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَارَصَ (taqāraṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
